meta.name: analytical-method-validation
meta.description: Plan, execute, and document validation, verification, and transfer of analytical procedures under the governing framework - ICH Q2(R2) and Q14, USP <1220>/<1225>/<1226>, ICH M10 bioanalytical, CLSI EP, or ISO/IEC 17025. Use for HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, CE, ICP-MS, dissolution, qNMR, qPCR, NIR, and ligand binding or cell-based assays whenever the question is whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose. Triggers include "method validation", "analytical method validation", "AMV", "validation protocol", "acceptance criteria", "linearity", "reportable range", "accuracy and precision", "repeatability", "intermediate precision", "recovery", "LOD", "LOQ", "detection limit", "quantitation limit", "specificity", "robustness", "method transfer", "method comparison", "Deming", "Passing-Bablok", "Bland-Altman", "equivalence testing", "OOS investigation", "ICH Q2", "Q2(R2)", "Q14", "USP 1225", "ICH M10", "incurred sample reanalysis", "ISR", "CLSI EP", and any request to show that an assay works.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证分析方法是否符合法规要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在制药或生物分析实验室中验证分析方法的合规性。
copy.tagline_en: Validate analytical methods for regulatory compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to validate analytical methods in pharma or bioanalysis labs.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可规划分析方法的验证、确认与转移：生成验证方案、计算线性/精密度/检测限、检查生物分析批次，并输出统计报告。它只报告结果，不替你做合格判定。
howto.when: 当用户提出“方法验证”“线性”“检测限”等要求，或询问某个分析程序是否适合其预期用途时触发。

say.text: 生成ICH Q2(R2)下的HPLC含量验证方案
say.note: 会先固定框架，再生成待填验收标准的方案骨架。

say.text: 检查calibration.csv的线性，最大回算误差2%
say.note: 会计算拟合统计并指出低浓度端的偏差。

say.text: 对比两个方法，设2%等效边界
say.note: 用TOST检验判断是否等效，并给出多种回归斜率。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can plan validation, verification, and transfer of analytical methods: generating protocols, computing linearity/precision/detection limits, checking bioanalytical runs, and outputting statistics. It reports only; it never concludes pass/fail.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions "method validation", "linearity", "detection limit", etc., or asks whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose.

say_en.text: Generate an ICH Q2(R2) validation protocol for an HPLC assay
say_en.note: It fixes the framework, then outputs a skeleton with criteria to fill.

say_en.text: Check calibration.csv for linearity, max back-calc error 2%
say_en.note: It computes fit statistics and flags low-end bias.

say_en.text: Compare two methods with a 2% equivalence margin
say_en.note: It runs TOST equivalence and reports several regression slopes.
